questions.question_text: An object is 30 cm from a concave mirror with focal length 15 cm. Its image forms
questions.option_a: 30 cm in front of the mirror
questions.explanation: At 2F a concave mirror forms a real image at 2F.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.question_text: A plane mirror rotates 10 degrees while the incident ray is fixed. The reflected ray rotates
questions.explanation: The reflected ray rotates by twice the mirror's rotation.

questions.question_text: A ray entering glass from air bends toward the normal because
questions.option_a: glass has a lower refractive index
questions.explanation: The optically denser glass slows light and bends it toward the normal.
questions.source: Original SSC-level practice; factual reference: NCERT Science textbooks and exemplar problems, https://ncert.nic.in/textbook.php

questions.explanation: Beyond the critical angle, light is reflected back into the denser medium.

questions.question_text: A red object under blue-only illumination appears dark because it
questions.option_b: reflects little of the incident blue light
questions.option_c: emits red light regardless of illumination
questions.explanation: Colour depends on reflected wavelengths; a red surface absorbs most blue light.
